#Text=Okay, let’s break down what we see in this map.
#Text=Overall Impression: This is a detailed street map of a portion of Cascadorna, in Florianópolis, Brazil.
#Text=It’s a fairly dense urban area with a complex network of streets.
#Text=The map is presented in a topographic style, showing elevation changes through color shading and contour lines.
